title: ES Premier trial can display Essentials in Cloud Connected environments
problem: The ES 8.8 licensing guide describes a Cloud Connected Premier trial displaying Essentials even while Cloud Connected features continue functioning. The prior VersionCompass ES licensing detail omitted the display qualification.

exclusions: Individual contract entitlement, native SOAR pairing, service authorization, and broader feature access remain separate.

scopeComparison: The display is described for the Cloud Connected Premier trial. Paid contract and runtime qualifications have separate scope.

impact.customerScenario: A reader is evaluating a Cloud Connected Premier trial whose interface displays Essentials.
impact.consequence: The displayed tier can be mistaken for a license or pairing failure.

confidence.rationale: The directly reviewed 8.8 trial section explicitly describes the behavior, and the pinned baseline licensing detail omitted it.

lifecycle.reason: Retained source coverage observation. The proposed report correction and live delivery are verified separately.

evidence.section: Trial license to evaluate Splunk Enterprise Security > Trial terms, expiration and Cloud Connected Premier trial display
evidence.statement: Exact supporting section in the scoped assessment.

documentRevision.qualification: Direct public response bytes. Publisher revision unknown.
